metadata.description: Method, routing and an approval-first change flow for the Orphex advertising-analytics MCP connection: how to find a capability, address a workspace, read the metric vocabulary before the numbers, which prepared method or report template answers an intent, and how to make a change the person asks for — preview, their explicit approval, then the change.

plugins.name: orphex-channel
plugins.description: A Claude Code channel that pushes Orphex events into a running session: a change request waiting for approval or confirm, one about to expire or settled, an ad disapproved, spend running into a cap, a connected account that lost access, a report that finished. Read with the MCP Events extension's events/poll; one-way.
